quest.title: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Dew-Kissed Chapter
quest.description: You once again encounter the illustrator Asagiri in Fontaine...
quest.rewards_formatted: Asagiri's Dedicated Fontaine Kamera x1, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: S—So cold... I definitely shouldn't have just gone out into the wind willy-nilly...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you okay? How'd you make it out this far all by yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: I'm... well... fine! I'm much better now! See, I'm not even coughing anymore.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Whoa! No need! I admit it, I sneaked out on my own! Happy?

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: I... I didn't have a choice. How could I possibly paint beautiful pictures if I just sat in Inazuma all the time?

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Even if I have you running around taking pictures for me, picture references can't compare to seeing things with your own eyes.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: So, I asked an author I worked with before to contact a merchant ship for me, and quietly hitched a ride with them so I could travel.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And you even brought all your painting tools with you...

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: But of course! The canvas is my very soul! How could I ever abandon any of them?

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Plus, my paintings are selling exceptionally well in Fontaine. A few Fontainian authors have even asked me to do the covers for their novels!

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Though... Apparently putting illustrations throughout novels isn't a thing for them! Truly strange...

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: #Oh, right... Since you happen to be here, {NICKNAME}... Would you mind helping me collect some reference materials?

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Excellent! With you helping out, I know the job's as good as done.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Okay, let me have a look. As it happens, I've received a few more commissions from some authors...

choices.text: Alright then, but don't go running off.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: I know! Not like I can deal with those clockwork meka anyway.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: When it comes to dealing with all kinds of weird monsters, you're the creme de la creme.

choices.text: Let me write back and check.
